question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer:** 'Option 3: Supercede'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **'Supercede**' is a common misspelling. The proper spelling is **'supersede'** (बदल देना). 
 
• **For example: **"The government's policy has been superseded by a new approach."
 
• **'Flimsy'** (दुर्बल), **'Etiquette'** (शिष्टाचार) and** 'Intercede'** (हस्तक्षेप करना) are all correctly spelled and are excluded from this context.

Therefore, the erroneous spelling is: **Supercede'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• 'Flimsy' (दुर्बल) often refers to something that is inadequate in quantity, size, or intensity.
 
• 'Etiquette' (शिष्टाचार) refers to polite behavior in society.
 
• 'Intercede' (हस्तक्षेप करना) is to intervene or mediate.
